catalog_temporal_assumption: The seeded product catalog is treated as the candidate catalog for this experiment. Product creation timestamps are excluded because all seeded products have post-cutoff timestamps.
ranking_method: Products personally viewed before cutoff and not previously purchased are ranked first by preferred category, then individual customer product-view frequency. Category and global popularity are deterministic tie-breakers.
score_definition: Number of pre-cutoff page views by the individual customer for the recommended product.
availability_limitation: Active status and stock quantity are based on the current catalog snapshot. Historical stock availability cannot be verified.
